name: Astral Imagea Park
description: An offline arcadia meticulously built by the IPC for its newest mystery box product, "Astral Imagea." Here, you can freely explore all the surprises they have to offer.
introduction:
◆ Astral Imagea Park ◆
● The IPC's latest Trendible, Astral Imagea, has arrived in Astropolis! Head over to get your very own Imagea. Plus, the two-player co-op "Astral Slammers Squad!" Challenge awaits. Step right up and don't miss out~

◆ Park Souvenir ◆
● During the event, Trailblazers can directly claim 6 Trendible Vouchers at the Astral Imagea Park upon logging in.

◆ Astral Trendible ◆
● During the event, Trailblazers can use Trendible Vouchers in Astral Trendible to open Imagea mystery boxes and obtain Classic Edition Chimera, Classic Edition Kitty Furb, Collector's Edition Chimera, and Collector's Edition Kitty Furb Astral Imageas.
● During the event, Trailblazers can reclaim extra Classic Edition Chimera and Classic Edition Kitty Furb Astral Imageas into Wishing Stardust, which can be traded for Trendible Vouchers at the Cosmetics Store.
● Trailblazers can trade Astral Imageas with Friends in the Trade Plaza. The Trade Plaza is permanently open.
● After the event ends, extra Trendible Vouchers and Wishing Stardust will not be reclaimed. Please pay attention to the event duration.
● Trailblazers can form an Imagea squad with up to 3 Astral Imageas and summon the squad on the map.
● Trailblazers can place pets at the Astral Imagea Park in Life Sciences Institute and the Party Car, as well as visiting Friends' placement through the co-op visitation function.

◆ Astral Slammers Squad! ◆
● Dispatch your pet partners to battle it out against the baby seals.
● When the Trailblazer teams up with other Trailblazers, each must dispatch 2 pet partners to face off against the baby seal enemies.
● In addition to their own pets, the Trailblazer can also use trial pets.
● "Astral Slammers Squad!" is a Conventional Memoir event. Achieving victory in Normal and Hard modes will grant the corresponding permanent rewards.
